aoi.name: เขตคลองสาน
aoi.geometry_source: OpenStreetMap relation R3147280 via Nominatim lookup
aoi.rationale: Chronically flooded west-bank district on the Chao Phraya with dense low-rise housing, mid-rise height variation, and multiple approved BMA flood-risk records. 5.96 km2 sits inside the plan's 5-10 km2 pilot corridor target.

analysis_crs_decision.label: WGS 84 / UTM zone 47N
analysis_crs_decision.justification: Bangkok at 13.7N/100.5E falls in UTM zone 47. The pilot centroid is about 1.5 degrees from the 99E central meridian, giving a point scale factor near 1.000 with sub-0.1 percent length distortion. Metric distance, area, buffering and routing cost are therefore reliable at pilot scale. Selected explicitly rather than inferred from coordinate ranges.
rejected: EPSG:4326 - degrees are not metric; area and distance results would be wrong.
EPSG:3857 - Web Mercator inflates area at this latitude; acceptable for display tiles only.
EPSG:32648 - wrong zone; Bangkok is west of the 102E boundary.

aggregation_grid.note: Internal analysis uses the 100 m WorldPop base grid. Public products start at 1 km per the privacy rule, with 500 m mesh volumes available only as an internal artefact pending disclosure review.

notes: analysis_crs and aggregation_grid were resolved from staged-source inspection, not guessed from coordinate ranges.
Any change to aoi or analysis_crs creates a new aoi_version and invalidates cached runs.
